mapper.select: SELECT source_type,source_id,module,title,status,path,created_at FROM () permitted ORDER BY created_at DESC,source_type,source_id DESC LIMIT #{page.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM factory_onboarding_audit WHERE applicant_user_id=#{user})

SELECT id FROM customer_service_context WHERE user_id=#{user} AND source_type=#{source.sourceType} AND source_id=#{source.sourceId} AND (active_role=#{role} OR (#{role}='factory' AND source_type='factory_onboarding' AND active_role='applicant')) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM admin_case_relation r JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=r.admin_case_id WHERE r.relation_type=#{source.sourceType} AND r.relation_id=#{source.sourceId} AND r.is_primary=1 AND c.case_type='customer_service' AND c.buyer_user_id=#{user} AND c.case_status!='cancelled' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,(c.case_status='closed') ASC,c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM customer_service_context x JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=x.admin_case_id JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=c.id AND r.is_primary=1 AND r.relation_type=x.source_type AND r.relation_id=x.source_id WHERE x.id=#{id} AND x.user_id=#{user} AND c.buyer_user_id=#{user} AND c.case_type='customer_service' AND c.case_status!='cancelled'
mapper.sql: id,user_id,active_role,source_type,source_id,title_snapshot AS title,status_snapshot,summary_snapshot AS summary, return_page_path,context_status,expire_at,context_token_hash AS token_hash,admin_case_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM customer_service_context WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
